sourceNote: Provider x credential-family taxonomy (issue #502). Grounded in benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts contract review text and benchmarks/detectors.json; every entry with an empty detectors list carries a source or note explaining why it is not detector-covered. Consumed by A2 (#503) and A3 (#504); zero-detector families become `unsupported` candidates in A8's support-matrix.json (#509).

families.name: IAM user access key
families.description: Long-term access key ID for an IAM user, prefixed AKIA.

families.name: STS temporary access key
families.description: Short-lived access key ID issued by AWS STS, prefixed ASIA; requires an accompanying session token.
families.note: aws-access-key's pattern is anchored to AKIA only (benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts contract), so ASIA values are not matched. classifyFixture already special-cases a bare AWS positive as policy, not must-redact, because "some legacy ASIA values also use digits outside the base32 alphabet".

families.name: STS service bearer token
families.description: AWS STS service-issued bearer credential, prefixed ABIA.
families.note: Documented in the same IAM unique-identifier prefix table as AKIA/ASIA; not matched by the AKIA-only pattern.

families.name: Context-specific credential
families.description: Context-specific temporary credential, prefixed ACCA.
families.note: Documented in the same IAM unique-identifier prefix table as AKIA/ASIA; not matched by the AKIA-only pattern.

families.name: IAM user secret access key
families.description: The 40-character secret paired with an IAM user access key ID. Has no distinguishing prefix or lexical marker.
families.note: The aws-access-key contract's companion field states a separate 40-character secret access key is required alongside the access key ID; this project has no dedicated detector for the secret half, which carries no stable prefix to anchor on.

families.name: Classic personal access token
families.description: Classic PAT, prefixed ghp_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth app access token, prefixed gho_.

families.name: GitHub App user-to-server token
families.description: GitHub App user-to-server token, prefixed ghu_.

families.name: GitHub App server-to-server token
families.description: GitHub App installation (server-to-server) token, prefixed ghs_.

families.name: OAuth refresh token
families.description: OAuth app refresh token, prefixed ghr_.

families.name: Fine-grained personal access token
families.description: Repository- and permission-scoped PAT, prefixed github_pat_.
families.note: Named explicitly in issue #502 as a family the github-token detector does not cover: its pattern only matches the ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_ underscore-plus-36-character-body shape, which github_pat_ does not fit. Measured as the Beta.8 arrival family github-fine-grained-pat (#211, research #223): only the github_pat_ prefix is provider-documented; the 22 + _ + 59 body is community/tool evidence kept provisional, with no checksum or fixed 11 lead claimed.

families.name: Legacy personal access token
families.description: Legacy-format PAT, prefixed glpat- with a 20-character body.

families.name: Routable personal access token
families.description: Newer routable PAT format described on the same token-prefix page.
families.note: gitlab-token's contract review states explicitly that routable tokens are not covered by the 20-character-body pattern.

families.name: Secret API key
families.description: sk- prefixed secret API key, including project- and service-account-scoped variants (sk-proj-, sk-svcacct-).

families.name: Secret API key
families.description: sk-ant- prefixed secret API key.

families.name: Custom app access token
families.description: Access token for a store-installed custom app, prefixed shpat_.

families.name: Public app access token
families.description: Access token for a public/listed app, prefixed shppa_.

families.name: Service token
families.description: Standard Vault service token, prefixed hvs.

families.name: Batch token
families.description: Lightweight, non-renewable Vault batch token, prefixed hvb.

families.name: Recovery token
families.description: Vault recovery operation token, prefixed hvr.

families.name: Live secret key
families.description: Live-mode secret key, prefixed sk_live_.

families.name: Test secret key
families.description: Test-mode secret key, prefixed sk_test_.

families.name: Live restricted key
families.description: Live-mode restricted-permission key, prefixed rk_live_.

families.name: Test restricted key
families.description: Test-mode restricted-permission key, prefixed rk_test_.

families.name: Organization API key
families.description: Organization-scoped secret key, prefixed sk_org_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes sk_org_ values to "this variant needs a separate format contract; related detector support is not evidence of parity", so it is not claimed by stripe-token's live/test secret-key pattern.

families.name: Webhook signing secret
families.description: Webhook endpoint signing secret, prefixed whsec_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: Same classifyFixture guard as the organization API key covers whsec_ values; stripe-token's pattern does not match them. Measured as the context-gated Beta.8 arrival family stripe-webhook-signing-secret (#211, research #224): Stripe documents the whsec_ prefix only; the body width and alphabet stay provisional (32 alphanumerics is a provider example, not a grammar; Stripe's own scrubber admits + / =).

families.name: Bot token
families.description: Bot user OAuth token, prefixed xoxb-.

families.name: User token
families.description: User OAuth token, prefixed xoxp-.
families.note: slack-token's contract lists xoxp- among the provider-documented prefixes but its pattern only matches xoxb-.

families.name: App-level token
families.description: App-level token, prefixed xapp-.
families.note: Documented alongside xoxb- in the same provider prefix table; not matched by the bot-token-only pattern. Measured as the Beta.8 arrival family slack-app-level-token (#211, research #222): only the xapp- prefix is provider-documented; section widths and alphabet are tool-only and contradictory (4-section 97-character vs Nosey Parker's 2-section 42-character) and stay unresolved.

families.name: Workflow webhook token
families.description: Workflow webhook trigger token, prefixed xwfp-.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes xwfp- values to the "needs a separate format contract" guard.

families.name: API token
families.description: pypi- prefixed base64-encoded macaroon.

families.name: API token
families.description: hf_ prefixed access token.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Personal access token, prefixed dckr_pat_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth access token, prefixed dckr_oat_.

families.name: Scannable API token
families.description: cfut_ prefixed scannable API token format.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Personal access token, prefixed dop_v1_.

families.name: OAuth token
families.description: OAuth token, prefixed doo_v1_.

families.name: Refresh token
families.description: Refresh token, prefixed dor_v1_.

families.name: Personal API key
families.description: Personal API key, prefixed lin_api_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth access token, prefixed lin_oauth_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes lin_oauth_ values to the "needs a separate format contract; related detector support is not evidence of parity" guard.

families.name: Project secret key
families.description: Project-scoped secret API key, prefixed sb_secret_.
families.note: supabase-token's contract is T1 since #207 (research #231): Supabase's self-hosting page documents sb_secret_ + 22-character random part + _ + 8-character checksum and says hosted keys use the same format; the base64url alphabet and the sha256 checksum are provider code only. The older 40-alphanumeric detector-coverage positives predate that grammar and are retained as policy regressions.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Management-API personal access token, prefixed sbp_/sbp_v0_.
families.note: #81 backfilled the supabase-management-token detector (redact-secret#535). Deliberately independent of supabase:secret-key's evidence, per https://github.com/redact-secret/redact-secret/blob/de6add470321f40d7b1cb36808d9f4559e6c2e99/docs/decisions/2026-09-20-scope-supabase-management-token-and-secret-key-independence.md.

families.name: Access token
families.description: Vercel REST API access token.
families.note: vercel-token is T0/pending: the REST API reference documents no token prefix, and the corpus's five candidate vcp_/vci_/vca_/vcr_/vck_ shapes are unconfirmed against provider documentation, so they are not split into separate families here.

families.name: Granular access token
families.description: 2021-09 format token with a Base62 CRC32 checksum, prefixed npm_.

families.name: Legacy token
families.description: Pre-2021 unprefixed UUID-format token.
families.note: npm-token's own provider source is the changelog announcing the npm_ prefix scheme as a replacement, implying the prior UUID-format token predates it; that legacy shape is not matched by the npm_-prefixed pattern.

families.name: Generic API key
families.description: AIza prefixed general-purpose API key.

families.name: OAuth2 credential
families.description: OAuth2 client secret, access token or refresh token.
families.note: google-api-key's contract review notes the pinned TruffleHog detectors separately cover Gemini and OAuth2 credentials, not this generic AIza API-key shape.

families.name: API key
families.description: SG. prefixed API key (full-access and restricted-access permission scopes share this format).

families.name: Application client secret
families.description: Client secret value for an app registration, with a digit+Q~ marker.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: 84-character PAT with a fixed AZDO signature at positions 76-80.

families.name: Legacy integration token
families.description: secret_ prefixed integration token.

families.name: Integration token
families.description: ntn_ prefixed integration token from Notion's 2024-09 rollout.
families.note: notion-token's contract review states this current ntn_-prefixed format has no contract here; the pinned gitleaks rule targets it instead of the legacy secret_ shape. Measured as the Beta.8 arrival family notion-integration-token (#211, research #225), separate from notion:legacy-integration-token: the ntn_ prefix is provider-documented, the 11-digit + 35-character body is tool-only and provisional, and PAT/OAuth/org-bot roles that may share the prefix are not merged into it.

families.name: API token
families.description: ATAT prefixed API token (minimum-length contract; Atlassian disclaims a fixed length).

families.name: Access token
families.description: ATCT prefixed access token.
families.note: atlassian-api-token's contract review states the pinned TruffleHog detector targets the distinct ATCT access-token family, not the ATAT-prefixed API-token shape.

families.name: Account auth token
families.description: 32-character lowercase-hex account auth token.

families.name: API key secret
families.description: 32-character API key secret.

families.name: Bot token
families.description: digits:secret bot token.

families.name: Bot token
families.description: Three-segment base64url bot token.

families.name: User auth token
families.description: sntryu_ prefixed personal auth token.

families.name: Organization auth token
families.description: sntrys_ prefixed organization auth token.

families.name: API key
families.description: 32-character API key.

families.name: Application key (ddapp_-prefixed)
families.description: Current application key: literal ddapp_ prefix, then 34 alphanumeric characters (40 total).
families.note: redact-secret#671 (product PR #679) split the legacy bare-hex generation into datadog:application-key-legacy; this family keeps the ddapp_ shape only.

families.name: Application key (legacy 40-hex)
families.description: Pre-ddapp_ 40-character lowercase-hex application key, still accepted by Datadog; recognized only beside a same-line DD_APPLICATION_KEY / datadog marker.
families.note: redact-secret#671 (product PR #679). Scored as policy (no value grammar), like datadog:api-key.

families.name: Service account token
families.description: glsa_ prefixed service account token.

families.name: Cloud access policy token
families.description: glc_ prefixed Cloud access policy token.

families.name: User API key
families.description: NRAK- prefixed user API key.

families.name: License key
families.description: 40-character hexadecimal license key.

families.name: Legacy FCM server key
families.description: Legacy Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP/XMPP server key: literal AAAA prefix, 7 bytes, a literal ":", then 140 bytes.
families.note: #81 backfilled the firebase-server-key detector (redact-secret#543). Service-account JSON exports and AIza-prefixed keys are covered elsewhere (private-key, google-api-key), not this family.

families.name: User token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise user API token, 14 alphanumeric bytes, the literal .atlasv1. marker, then 67 alphanumeric bytes.

families.name: Organization token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise organization API token; identical grammar to the user token.

families.name: Team token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise team API token; identical grammar to the user token.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud personal access token, prefixed pul-.

families.name: Organization access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud organization access token; identical grammar to the personal token.

families.name: Team access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud team access token; identical grammar to the personal token.

families.name: PEM-encoded private key
families.description: RFC 7468 textual encoding of private key material (any algorithm), not tied to a single provider.

families.name: JSON Web Token
families.description: RFC 7519 compact-serialization token, not tied to a single issuer.

families.name: Bearer credential
families.description: RFC 6750 Authorization: Bearer value; a transport scheme, not a provider-specific format.

families.name: Connection-string password
families.description: Password embedded in a URI's userinfo component per RFC 3986.

families.name: OTP seed
families.description: Base32 secret parameter of an otpauth:// key URI.

families.name: Unclassified assignment literal
families.description: Arbitrary literal in a sensitive-looking assignment, masked as project policy rather than a provider format.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: dapi-prefixed 32-hex personal access token, optionally suffixed -<digit> after rotation.
families.note: redact-secret#308 (product PR #665) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. OAuth client secrets are a separately documented scope extension, not this family.

families.name: Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed)
families.description: API secret created after 2025-07-30: literal cflt prefix, then 54 base64-alphabet body bytes and a 6-byte checksum (standard Base64 of the little-endian CRC32 of those 54 bytes), 64 in total.
families.note: redact-secret#309 (product PR #667) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6 and checks the prefix and length only. #209 (research #234): the provider publishes the checksum algorithm, so the contract validates it. The API key ID ("not considered secret information") is never a positive.

families.name: Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30)
families.description: Unprefixed 64-byte base64-body API secret, recognized only beside a same-line confluent keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#309 (product PR #667). Scored as policy (no value grammar), like twilio:auth-token.

families.name: API key
families.description: PMAK-prefixed API key: 24 hex bytes, a literal "-", then 34 hex bytes (59-byte body); sent in the X-API-Key header.
families.note: redact-secret#310 (product PR #668) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. The provider page documents only the header, so the grammar is tool-corroborated (T2).

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: nfp_-prefixed personal access token: 36 bytes of [A-Za-z0-9_], 40 characters total.
families.note: redact-secret#311 (product PR #666) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it.

families.name: CLI, OAuth, app and build tokens (nfc_/nfo_/nfu_/nfb_)
families.description: The announcement's four other nf-prefixed token classes, sharing the personal access token's scheme but issued for the CLI, OAuth flows, app.netlify.com and builds.
families.note: Out of redact-secret#311's explicit scope; each is a distinct credential, so none is a control or positive for netlify:personal-access-token.

families.name: OAuth access token (HRKU-prefixed)
families.description: HRKU- prefixed OAuth access token in its two documented prefixed generations: 41 characters (HRKU- plus a UUID, granted 2024-04-01 to 2025-04-22) and 65 characters (HRKU- plus 60 of [A-Za-z0-9_-], granted from 2025-04-23, observed to begin AA).
families.note: redact-secret#312 (product PR #675) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6 and froze the 65-character HRKU-AA grammar only. #209 (research #235): changelog-items/3175 documents the 41-character HRKU-<uuid> generation as the previous length, so it is in this family's contract, not an undocumented-width variant; the AA start of the 65-character form is example- and tool-observed, not provider-stated. The pre-2024 bare-UUID generation is heroku:legacy-api-key.

families.name: Legacy API key (bare UUID)
families.description: Pre-2024-04 unprefixed 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID token, still valid until regenerated; recognized only beside a same-line heroku keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#312 (product PR #675). Scored as policy (no value grammar), like twilio:auth-token. The later HRKU-<uuid> (41 characters) and HRKU-AA (65) generations are provider-documented and belong to heroku:oauth-access-token (#209, #232). An app id on a heroku-named line is a public-id control; both keyword-gated peers flag it, and the product has excluded identifier-shaped keys since redact-secret#714.

families.name: Marketing API key
families.description: 32-hex API key followed by a literal -us and a one- or two-digit data-center number; recognized only beside a same-line mailchimp keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#313 (product PR #678) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. Mandrill (transactional) keys are a separate product and not this family.

families.name: Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key
families.description: key- followed by 32 lowercase alphanumeric bytes; Mailgun's current API reference shows the same shape for the account HTTP signing key. Recognized only beside a same-line mailgun keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#314 (product PR #680) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. One detector covers both credentials because the provider's current interface gives them one shape.

families.name: Public validation key (pubkey-)
families.description: pubkey- followed by 32 bytes; Mailgun's public email-validation key, not a secret.
families.note: Documented public per redact-secret#314's scope; gitleaks 8.30.1's mailgun-pub-key rule still flags it, which the mailgun-api-key public-id control records.

families.name: Legacy 32-8-8 hex signing key
families.description: Dash-segmented 32-8-8 hex triplet both pinned tools call a signing key; absent from Mailgun's current API reference.
families.note: Known unsupported legacy variant per redact-secret#314 (product PR #680); not fixtured because the provider no longer documents it.

families.name: Management API token (SSWS)
families.description: 00-prefixed 42-character API token sent as Authorization: SSWS; recognized beside the SSWS scheme or a same-line okta keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#315 (product PR #681) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. OAuth access/ID tokens are JWTs and belong to the jwt family, not this one.

families.name: API token
families.description: r8_ prefixed API token; the provider documents a 40-character total (a 37-character body) and does not state the body alphabet.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family (#208, research #217): no product detector at the pinned registry revision; measured as the arrival target replicate-api-token (benchmarks/lib/beta8/208.ts). The body alphabet is peer-contested (TruffleHog admits - and _; flare-redact alphanumeric only) and stays provisional. The cog/r8.im login token's relation to this token is undocumented and not claimed. Product counterpart redact-secret/redact-secret#727.

families.name: API key
families.description: gsk_ prefixed API key; the 52-character alphanumeric body is tool-corroborated, not provider-stated.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family (#208, research #218): no product detector at the pinned registry revision; measured as the arrival target groq-api-key at T2. The observed WGdyb3FY body segment is a four-sample maintainer observation recorded as unresolved, not a grammar requirement; the community 48-character body proposal is unsupported. Not Grok/xAI. Product counterpart redact-secret/redact-secret#727.

families.name: API key
families.description: xai- prefixed API key; the 80-character body is documented only by the provider's example and corroborated by tools.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family (#208, research #216): no product detector at the pinned registry revision; measured as the arrival target xai-api-key at T2. Management keys (tool-reported xai-token- prefix, XAI_MANAGEMENT_KEY) are a separate credential and not members of this family; no taxonomy family is added for them until the provider documents a format. Product counterpart redact-secret/redact-secret#727.

families.name: Inference API key
families.description: sk-or-v1- followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (73 characters), per OpenRouter's secret-format documentation.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family (#208, research #220): no product detector at the pinned registry revision; measured as the arrival target openrouter-api-key. Management keys (sk-or-mgmt-) are openrouter:management-api-key, not members of this family. The public key hash has the same 64-hex body shape without the prefix. Product counterpart redact-secret/redact-secret#727.

families.name: Management API key
families.description: sk-or-mgmt- prefixed management (formerly provisioning) key for the /api/v1/keys routes; cannot call completion endpoints. Body length and alphabet are undocumented.
families.note: Unsupported and unclaimed (#208, research #220): a real secret, but no body grammar is published and no product detector, contract or fixture targets it. It is never used as a benign control of openrouter:api-key.

families.name: API key (personal access token or service key)
families.description: LangSmith API key in its two documented roles, personal access token (lsv2_pt_) and workspace/org service key (lsv2_sk_); the 32+10 lowercase-hex segment grammar is tool-corroborated.
families.note: No product detector at the pinned registry revision; redact-secret/redact-secret#728 (blocked by #726) is open. Arrival evidence in benchmarks/lib/beta8/210.ts (#210, research #219). Legacy ls__ keys, license keys, SCIM tokens, OAuth tokens and deployment keys are separate credentials this family does not claim.

families.name: Secret API key
families.description: Langfuse project/organization secret key as the issuer mints it: sk-lf- plus a lowercase UUIDv4 (42 characters). Paired with the public pk-lf- key.
families.note: No product detector at the pinned registry revision; redact-secret/redact-secret#728 (blocked by #726) is open. Arrival evidence in benchmarks/lib/beta8/210.ts (#210, research #221). Self-hosted operator-defined values and a possible sk-lf-gw- gateway shape are recorded but not claimed.

families.name: API key
families.description: pplx--prefixed API key; the 48-character alphanumeric body is tool-corroborated, not provider-stated.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family perplexity-api-key (#212, research #226); no product detector at the pinned registry revision.

families.name: API key
families.description: fw_-prefixed API key; 22- and 24-character bodies are observed, not documented.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family fireworks-ai-api-key (#212, research #227). The fpk_ Fire Pass key and any unprefixed legacy key are not covered.

families.name: API key (pcsk_)
families.description: Current pcsk_<label>_<secret> API key; prefix from provider code, segment widths tool-corroborated.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family pinecone-api-key (#212, research #228). The Admin API docs describe an unobserved pckey_ prefix; that contradiction is unresolved.

families.name: Legacy API key (bare UUID)
families.description: Legacy bare-UUID API key, identical in shape to Pinecone key/project/service-account ids; recognized only beside a same-line Pinecone API-key identifier.
families.note: Beta.8 context-gated arrival family pinecone-api-key-legacy (#212, research #228); the UUID shape is corroborated by unpinned tools only.

families.name: Runner authentication token
families.description: glrt--prefixed runner authentication token: a 20-character legacy body, or the routable base64url payload with a base36 length holder and CRC32 checksum.
families.note: Beta.8 arrival family gitlab-runner-authentication-token (#212, research #230). glrtr-, instance-prefixed and unversioned routable variants are not claimed. gitlab-token contract covers glpat- only.
